method: Water-quality treatment and materials values (nutrient removal targets, bioretention media composition, phosphorus limits, compost, underdrain size and media permeability) read by hand from every atlas manual with its own rules. Candidate sentences were found by text search and each was read and judged: is it this rule, stated as a requirement (ok) or as a recommendation or typical value (typical)? Ranges are recorded at their lower end for minimums (sand share, organic matter, compost organic matter, permeability, underdrain size) and at their upper end for maximums (clay, phosphorus). Media phosphorus is recorded only where it is given as a P-index or in mg/kg; P2O5 limits are left out. Statistics count one value per state (the median of that state's manuals).
